name: Three-Word Littlestone-Maximal Witness
properties: It is Littlestone-maximal of dimension one, but is not $(3,1)$-thicket-maximum because its thicket shatter value is three rather than four. It is also $(1,1)$-thicket-maximum, tree-support-saturated, and labeled-tree-saturated. Its one-inclusion graph is disconnected (the word $011$ is isolated), so it is not a partial cube.
